name: High School Volunteer and Teen Center Tutor (Mt. Madonna YMCA, Morgan Hill)
city: Morgan Hill, CA (171 W Edmundson Ave)
what_you_do: You help at the teen center with games and homework. You can also help at the senior center, help coach youth sports or tutor students.
who_can_apply: High school students. The postings list no other rules.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The posting says the hours count as community service hours.
duration: Teen center tutoring is Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday; hours to be set.
deadline_text: The volunteer posting runs June 1, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027 (9 spots listed). The tutor posting runs Sept 1, 2026 to Sept 1, 2027 (24 spots listed).
how_to_apply: Open the posting on the YMCA volunteer site and click the Volunteer button. Questions about tutoring? Contact Liz Burke at elizabeth.burke@ymcasv.org or 408-310-4257.
notes: The posting lists the City of Morgan Hill as a partner. It does not give a minimum age or say if there is a background check. So ask before you sign up. The same site marks other roles as Great for Teens. One is a youth basketball coach at the El Camino YMCA in Mountain View. That season runs Jan 11 to March 27 (no year given). It is 1 hour of practice a week plus a 1 hour Saturday game.
